user.title: Tailscale OAuth client
user.description: Enter an OAuth Client ID and Secret with policy_file write permission. The client’s tailnet is selected automatically. Existing app connector domains become switches.

initial_group.title: Domain group
initial_group.description: Groups are stored only in Home Assistant. Select domains from one or more app connectors. The group switch changes all members together.

finish.title: Complete registration
finish.description: Existing app connector domains will be deduplicated and completed into domain / *.domain pairs when you finish. Other policy sections are preserved. You can manage groups later in Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tailscale API or obtain an OAuth token. Check connectivity and try again.
error.policy_forbidden: Tailscale ACL API returned HTTP 403. Check the OAuth client’s policy_file permission and access to its tailnet.
error.tailnet_not_found: Tailscale ACL API returned HTTP 404. The OAuth client’s tailnet policy could not be found.
error.api_error: Tailscale ACL API returned an error. Check the Home Assistant log for the HTTP status.
error.invalid_policy: The policy returned by Tailscale could not be parsed. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_group: Check the group name and selected domains. If the group changed or was deleted elsewhere, reopen the editor.

abort.already_configured: This OAuth client is already configured.

change.title: Edit domains for {connector}
change.description: The domain and *.domain are saved as a pair. Delete removes the switch too, including domains already absent from the ACL.

domains.title: Manage app connector domains
domains.description: Choose an existing app connector and add, remove, or rename a domain pair.

group_details.title: Domain group
group_details.description: Groups are stored only in Home Assistant. Select domains from one or more app connectors. The group switch changes all members together.

error.invalid_domains: Check the domain format and the app connector’s current domain list.
error.cannot_connect: Could not save or refresh the policy.
error.invalid_group: Check the group name and selected domains. If the group changed or was deleted elsewhere, reopen the editor.

abort.no_connectors: No editable app connectors with an explicit domain list were found.
abort.no_domains: This app connector has no domains yet.

get_acl.name: Get ACL
get_acl.description: Read the current JSONC policy and ETag. Administrator access is required.

entry_id.name: Integration
entry_id.description: Select the configured Tailscale Updator integration.

set_acl.name: Edit app connectors
set_acl.description: Edit only existing nodeAttrs app-connectors arrays using the current ETag. Changes to grants, SSH, tags, groups, targets or other policy fields are rejected. Other source text is preserved.

entry_id.name: Integration
entry_id.description: Select the configured Tailscale Updator integration.

expected_etag.name: Expected ETag
expected_etag.description: ETag returned by Get ACL. Prevents overwriting concurrent changes.

add_domains.name: Add domains
add_domains.description: Add each domain and its wildcard as a pair to an existing app connector. Administrator access is required.

entry_id.description: Select the configured Tailscale Updator integration.

remove_domains.name: Remove domains
remove_domains.description: Delete each domain and its wildcard from the ACL and remove their Home Assistant switch. To keep an Off switch, use Turn off instead. Administrator access is required.
